origin: Future Detector hydro back-test v2 (hydro/run_v2.py, focus_v2.py), run 2026-11-14; raw outputs copied to data/reference/fd_backtest/. Independent of the Patronus generation and Kariba models.
design: Train on target months <= 2020, test 2021-01..2025-12 (one split, no CV). Learner picked on a 2018-2020 validation split (logistic regression won for every model). Pooled across units. Features from hand-drawn catchment boxes. No publication-lag adjustment (month t assumed known at end of t). Uncalibrated probabilities. Metrics: AUC-PR and Brier skill vs climatology; 300 block-bootstrap resamples over test months, 90% intervals. Crisis lead = longest lead with P >= 0.40.

labels.short: Monthly hydro value below the 20th percentile of the same calendar month over training years <= 2020 (the 'brief's label'; main view).
labels.short_adj: Value / median of same calendar month in the previous 5 years, shortfall when below the unit's training 20th percentile (capacity-corrected second view; absorbs multi-year droughts).

units.kariba_label: G-REALM 10-day altimetry, lake 000394, monthly mean level (storage, not generation)

models.climatology: unit x calendar-month shortfall rate in training
models.hydro_history: logistic on recent hydro anomalies only
models.signals_v1: GPCP rain, CPC soil, CSR GRACE, ONI (no hydro history)
models.signals_v2: IMERG, JPL+CSR GRACE detrended, GRACE-DA, SMAP, reservoir storage, ONI (no hydro history)
models.hydro_storage: hydro history + observed reservoir storage (ONS EAR/ENA, G-REALM levels)

headline.text: Best model ranks shortfall months x2.06 better than climatology at 1 month, x1.48 at 3 and x1.25 at 6 (AUC-PR ratio; 90% block-bootstrap intervals above 1).
x1.14-1.26 better than persistence at 1-6 months (all 90% intervals above 1).
Pooled across 67 units, water signals add nothing beyond recent generation: full v2 / hydro history x1.01 at 1 month, x0.98 at 3, x0.92 at 6.
Where storage is observed (Brazil, ONS EAR/ENA, 5 units) it helps: x1.08-x1.29 over hydro history at 1-6 months (intervals above 1). Brief's label only; Brier skill negative from 3 months.

Brazil SE/CO 2021 (onset 2021-07) flagged 3 months ahead by the signals-only model (P 0.62 / 0.76 / 0.84 at 3/2/1 months; climatology 0.19). Kariba April 2024 record-low level: P 0.51 / 0.58 at 4/3 months from rain/soil/GRACE/ENSO alone. Missed: Sichuan 2022, Vietnam 2023, Ecuador 2024 (full model), Brazil national.

kariba_strict.definition: Signals-v1-only model (no lake-level input), P(level below calendar-month p20) by target month and lead. Record-low months = below the 1993-2020 calendar-month minimum.

comparison_with_patronus: Label: Patronus uses capacity factor >= 15% below an expanding same-month median (base rate 16%); FD uses below the training-period 20th percentile of raw generation (test base rate 29%). AUC-PR values are not comparable across the two.
Split: Patronus uses blocked leave-one-year-out CV (12-month gap) plus a forward test from 2024; FD uses one split (train <= 2020, test 2021-2025).
Units: Patronus = 23 Ember-monthly countries + Sichuan; FD = 53 countries + 4 Brazil ONS subsystems + 10 US states (EIA), with Ember data back to 2000 where available, so more training years.
Crisis rule: Patronus alarm = P(any shortfall in next 6 months) >= 0.64 (tuned to <= 1 false alarm per country per 5 years); FD lead = P(shortfall in the onset month) >= 0.40 at each lead.
Latency: Patronus applies publication lags (Ember t-2, GRACE t-3); FD does not, so FD leads are optimistic by 1-3 months.

Kariba: both use G-REALM levels. Patronus forecasts usable % (warning < 20%) with a forward rolling test; FD scores a below-p20 level label, which was already true from 2022-03, so FD's 6-month Kariba 'lead' is persistence.
limitations: Probabilities are uncalibrated; Brier skill turns negative at 4-6 months on several subsets.
22 of 67 units have < 5 training years, so thresholds are thin.
Test period is drier than training (29% vs 21% shortfalls).
Brazil storage result rests on 5 correlated units (SIN is the sum of the 4 subsystems) and several comparisons on one test period.
China provincial (Sichuan) data could not be obtained (data.stats.gov.cn HTTP 403); CHN is national.
notes: Ratios are AUC-PR(model A) / AUC-PR(model B); ci90 from 300 block-bootstrap resamples over test months.
Keys in by_horizon.bootstrap are '<model>__vs__<model>' with short model ids from 'models'.
